# Penn Medicine

> > Academic medical center advancing healthcare through groundbreaking research, innovative treatments, and clinical excellence across neuroscience, maternal health, genetics, and therapeutic development.

Penn Medicine represents the University of Pennsylvania Health System and Perelman School of Medicine, featuring leading research institutes including the Lurie Autism Institute and Penn Translational Neuroscience Center. The organization pioneers advances in mRNA vaccine technology, RNA therapeutics, neurodegenerative disease research, and evidence-based clinical care.

## Key Topics

- Penn Medicine
- Perelman School of Medicine
- University of Pennsylvania
- mRNA vaccine technology
- Lurie Autism Institute
- RNA therapeutics
- Autism genetics and MECP2 gene
- Nancy Lurie Marks Prize for Autism Research
- Children's Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP)
- Maternal and child health
- Neuroscience research
- Lipid nanoparticle delivery
- Anesthesia safety
- Trigeminal neuralgia treatment
- Medical residency programs

## Breakthrough Research & Innovation

- [Study unlocks safer RNA therapies for inflammatory diseases](https://www.pennmedicine.org/news/study-unlocks-safer-rna-therapies-for-inflammatory-diseases): Penn Medicine discovers how to reduce inflammation from lipid nanoparticles
- [How mRNA vaccines could treat many infectious diseases](https://www.pennmedicine.org/news/how-mrna-vaccines-could-prevent-or-eliminate-infectious-diseases-beyond-covid19): Weissman and Karikó's mRNA vaccine technology expands beyond COVID-19
- [Lurie Autism Institute awards first Nancy Lurie Marks Prize for Autism Research](https://www.pennmedicine.org/news/lurie-autism-institute-awards-first-nancy-lurie-marks-prize-for-autism-research): Huda Y. Zoghbi receives inaugural Nancy Lurie Marks Prize for autism research

## Clinical Studies & Patient Safety

- [New study challenges fears about general anesthesia during C-section](https://www.pennmedicine.org/news/new-study-challenges-fears-about-general-anesthesia-during-c-section): Penn study clarifies general anesthesia risks during C-section deliveries
- [Cash transfers boost health in low- and middle-income countries](https://www.pennmedicine.org/news/cash-transfers-boost-health-in-low-and-middle-income-countries): Cash transfer programs improve maternal and child health in developing nations

## Patient Stories & Treatment Outcomes

- [Procedure relieves years of agony after unexplained toothache](https://www.pennmedicine.org/news/minimally-invasive-surgery-relieves-trigeminal-neuralgia-jaw-pain): Tom Murray finds relief from trigeminal neuralgia through minimally invasive surgery

- [Keeping the 'family' together as Crozer residents move to Penn](https://www.pennmedicine.org/news/keeping-the-family-together-as-crozer-residents-move-to-penn): Crozer residents relocate to Chester County Hospital maintaining care continuity
